name: Tokimeki Memorial 2 Substories Dancing Summer Vacation
original_name: ときめきメモリアル2 Substories Dancing Summer Vacation
source:
An original set of extra stories set in the TM2 timeline, inspired by the Drama Series from TM1 but with different gameplay.

DSV is set in the summer of the first year of high school.  While hanging out with the player, Kotobuki Miyuki got an enormous score in DDR and is invited to a national tournament. Believing it to be a fluke, she'll ask the protagonist to train her, and thus a summer of dancing begins. Shirayuki Miho and Yae Kaori also eventually become involved.
